about: Every Titanos check, once per tier, in the order the workflow jobs run them. tools/run_checks.py executes tiers from this file; its --sync-check compares the CI tiers with the workflow jobs step for step and fails on drift. Fields: run (the exact workflow command; python and node resolve to the local interpreter), needs (Python modules that must import), os (platform.system() names), tool (node), node_module (under node_modules/), requires_path, ci_only (never run locally), slow (skipped by --fast), note. slow marks checks measured at or above 8 s in one run on 26 Sep 2026 on a loaded Windows workstation (the broker checks in one full base run on 2 Oct 2026 on the same kind of host); timings vary with the host.

base.description: engine dependencies only, plus setuptools for the two public-export gates (PyYAML optional); no numpy, pillow or Node

checks.note: OPS (a): GET /v1/health/ready is 200 only while the registry is loaded and not reloading and, in broker role, no required upstream has an open breaker; 503 with a typed reason otherwise; public in keyed mode

OPS (b): gateway registration sends Authorization: Bearer from TITANOS_API_KEY or --key-env (titanos hivemind register-service, serve --register-with-gateway) against a loopback gateway stand-in in 49900-49949

OPS (c): titanos service install|start|stop|uninstall|status plans for Windows (Scheduled Task), Linux (systemd) and macOS (launchd), the owner-only environment file, dry run, the install preconditions and readiness wait, and the recorded commands; subprocess.run is replaced
OPS (d): keys create without --scope mints inference + models:read; that key lists models over the app while an inference-only key is 403; the documented examples carry models:read

OLLAMA: GET /api/version outside managed role, POST /api/show from the registry and the passive inspection, keep_alive (0 unloads after the answer, negative resident, a duration named in X-Titanos-Dropped) and options.num_ctx (honoured up to the largest native per-slot context, 400 context_limit above it, named on other backends), typed 400 refusals on /api/pull, /api/create, /api/copy and /api/delete; HiveMind's Ollama options object on /v1/chat/completions and /v1/completions (200 + X-Titanos-Ignored, num_ctx unnamed up to the largest per-slot native context and named above it, where /api/chat is 400 context_limit, never 422); synthetic seam

PERF: the 2026-10-06 serving defaults (limit_concurrency 64; native_slots 4 over native_context_size 8192, 2,048 tokens per slot) in Settings, a new NativeOptions, the broker precondition warning and uvicorn.run; the measured-and-kept serve defaults asserted; a saved registration keeps its values; CONFIGURATION, OPTION_PARITY, BROKER, OPERATIONS, NATIVE, PERFORMANCE and the deviation map state the same numbers; no model, process or listener

SAFETY: tracked files stay source: no file over 1 MiB outside the generated or vendored allowlist, no weight, audio, archive, binary or credential file name, no secret-shaped string (Hugging Face, NVIDIA, OpenAI/Anthropic, AWS, Google, GitHub, Slack, PEM) in UTF-8 or UTF-16 text; self-test over synthetic inputs; git ls-files read-only

SAFETY: tools/build_binary.py refuses coqui-tts, TTS, ultralytics, phonemizer(-fork), espeakng-loader and any declared GPL, AGPL or non-commercial distribution unless --allow-restricted names it, recorded in the plan and DEPENDENCIES.json; metadata doubles, no build

ADMISSION: titanos.gguf_header reads synthetic GGUF v3 headers (scalars, strings, kept and skipped arrays, per-layer KV heads), states the trained context and weight bytes, estimates the KV cache per cache type, caches by file version and refuses a wrong magic, version or byte order, a truncated header and an oversized string; no model, process or network

CONTEXT: options.num_ctx sizes a llama-cpp runtime's per-slot context to the next power of two up to the largest per-slot context (registration, TITANOS_NATIVE_MAX_SLOT_CONTEXT, GGUF trained context_length), above it named in X-Titanos-Ignored on /v1/chat/completions and 400 context_limit on /api/chat; NativePool.lease starts cold runtimes at the size, restarts idle ones, waits for busy ones, never resizes under require_loaded; --ctx-size argv; synthetic GGUF, fake runtimes, proxy seam

PLACEMENT: TITANOS_EXCLUDE_GPU_UUIDS accepts complete NVIDIA GPU UUIDs; automatic native placement takes the first visible GPU not excluded and fails when all are; an explicit excluded GPU fails closed; synthetic inventories, no GPU

ADMISSION: llama-cpp starts estimated from the GGUF header (weights, KV cache, compute margin) and admitted against injected free GPU memory minus TITANOS_ADMISSION_RESERVE_MIB (TITANOS_ADMISSION_FREE_MIB only lowers it; off/auto/on modes); refusals are 503 insufficient_device_memory with Retry-After before any directory, key or process; a refused resize keeps the running runtime; GET /api/models/memory reports the estimate (or the weights-size heuristic) and fits per fake GPU reading; no nvidia-smi, model or GPU

CHILD ENV: llama-server, its supervisor and the device probe start from an allowlist (titanos.child_env.allowlisted_env, TITANOS_CHILD_ENV_ALLOW extends it); provider variables, *_API_KEY, *_BASE_URL, *_TOKEN, *_SECRET, *_PASSWORD and vault env: names never reach a child, replica workers and FFmpeg included; synthetic environments, one Python child, a captured llama-server launch

HEALTH: TITANOS_HEALTH_PORT runs a second uvicorn listener for /healthz, /readyz and /v1/health/ready outside limit_concurrency; a real loopback pair shows the main port at 503 under the cap while the health port answers, other paths 404, both stop together; serve picks the runner only when the port is set

LOGS: TITANOS_LOG_FILE appends uvicorn, access and application lines to a file rotated at TITANOS_LOG_MAX_BYTES into TITANOS_LOG_BACKUPS files (every line kept while the backups hold them, the directory capped otherwise), TITANOS_LOG_MAX_AGE_DAYS prunes old rotations, the redaction filter covers the file, serve passes log_config only when set; temporary files, uvicorn replaced

RACE: run_owned's byte budget skips a file the child renames or deletes between listing and size read (progress.json.tmp replaced onto progress.json) and still reads a growing file's size from os.stat; the music progress read tolerates a missing file; injected stat failures plus 5 real jobs of 1,500 progress publications each, no failure
